description: This file contains unit tests for Amazon SQS streaming provider integration with Orleans. It defines a test fixture class 'SQSStreamTests' that configures an Orleans test cluster with specific SQS stream and DynamoDB storage configurations, and includes various test methods for different streaming scenarios involving producers and consumers within Orleans grains and clients.

classes.name: SQSStreamTests
classes.description: Test suite for verifying SQS streaming provider functionality with Orleans, including setup of stream configurations and multiple streaming test scenarios.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the Orleans test cluster with SQS stream providers and DynamoDB/Memory storage.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test runner before tests run.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Performs cleanup after tests, including deleting SQS queues used during testing.

methods.name: StreamTest_01_OneProducerGrainOneConsumerGrain
methods.description: Tests one-to-one streaming between a single producer and a single consumer grain.

methods.name: StreamTest_02_OneProducerGrainOneConsumerClient
methods.description: Tests one-to-one streaming between a producer grain and a consumer client.

methods.name: StreamTest_03_OneProducerClientOneConsumerGrain
methods.description: Tests one-to-one streaming between a producer client and a consumer grain.

methods.name: StreamTest_04_OneProducerClientOneConsumerClient
methods.description: Tests one-to-one streaming between a producer client and a consumer client.

methods.name: StreamTest_05_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Tests many-to-many streaming across different grains.

methods.name: StreamTest_06_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerGrainManyConsumerClients
methods.description: Tests many-to-many streaming with grains producing and clients consuming.

methods.name: StreamTest_07_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerClientsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Tests many-to-many streaming with clients producing and grains consuming.

methods.name: StreamTest_08_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerClientsManyConsumerClients
methods.description: Tests many-to-many streaming with clients producing and consuming.

methods.name: StreamTest_09_ManySame_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Tests many-to-many streaming with multiple grains producing and consuming.

methods.name: StreamTest_10_ManySame_ManyConsumerGrainsManyProducerGrains
methods.description: Tests the reverse of the previous scenario with consumer and producer grains swapped.

methods.name: StreamTest_11_ManySame_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerClients
methods.description: Tests streaming with multiple grains producing and multiple clients consuming.

methods.name: StreamTest_12_ManySame_ManyProducerClientsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Tests streaming with multiple clients producing and grains consuming.

methods.name: StreamTest_13_SameGrain_ConsumerFirstProducerLater
methods.description: Tests streaming where the same grain acts as consumer first, then producer.

methods.name: StreamTest_14_SameGrain_ProducerFirstConsumerLater
methods.description: Tests streaming where the same grain acts as producer first, then consumer.

methods.name: StreamTest_15_ConsumeAtProducersRequest
methods.description: Tests consumption triggered at the producer's request.

methods.name: StreamTest_MultipleStreams_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Tests multiple streams with many grains producing and consuming across different streams.

methods.name: StreamTest_MultipleStreams_ManyDifferent_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
methods.description: Same as above, with specific setup for multiple streams.
